fixed-grid method
fixed-grid method
(definition)
Definition:
Space decomposition into rectangular cells by overlaying a grid on it.If the cells are congruent (i.e.,of the same width, height, etc.), then the grid is said to be uniform.
See also
bucketing method
,
regular decomposition
.
